value.title: Faubourg Saint-Antoine
value.extract: The Faubourg Saint-Antoine (French pronunciation: [fobuʁ sɛ̃t‿ɑ̃twan]) was one of the traditional suburbs of Paris, France. It grew up to the east of the Bastille around the abbey of Saint-Antoine-des-Champs, and ran along the Rue du Faubourg Saint-Antoine.
